'''Koovis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Rescue Run">{{WEGCite|story=Rescue Run|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}</ref> in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]] [[Klev Natasken]] was captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on the world, prompting the Alliance to commit [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] to try and rescue him.<ref name="Rescue Run" />
